item.title: Shopify Fashion Store Revamp
item.description:

Scope of the redesign • Home page: a striking hero, curated lifestyle imagery, and clear paths to shop. • Product and collection pages: refined image galleries, concise size-guide pop-ups, and persuasive copy that supports higher-priced items. • Cart and checkout: simplified steps, trust badges, and mobile-first styling to reduce drop-off.

item.title: Luxury Car Dealership Website
item.description:
5000-10000 USD | I run a boutique showroom that specialises in luxury and high-performance vehicles and I need a website that turns online visitors into serious buyers. The look and feel must echo the premium brands I stock—think clean lines, high-resolution imagery, subtle animations, and a friction-free browsing flow on both mobile and desktop.
What matters most is the ability to showcase each vehicle with rich photos, detailed specifications, provenance information, and a prominent enquiry form that drops leads straight into my CRM. I also want an inventory section I can update myself without touching code, along with basic SEO foundations so new stock is indexed quickly.
Deliverables • Fully responsive site built on WordPress, Webflow, or another easy-to-maintain CMS • Custom inventory manager and vehicle page template (gallery, specs table, enquiry form) • Elegant landing, about, finance info, and contact pages matching the dealership’s brand palette • Lead-capture integration with my existing CRM and Google Analytics set-up • One-page style guide plus brief hand-over video showing how to add/edit cars and images
Acceptance criteria • Page load under 3 seconds on mobile (Lighthouse 90+ score) • Inventory edits visible live within 60 seconds of publishing • All enquiry submissions reach my CRM and send a confirmation email to the prospect
If this sounds within your wheelhouse, let’s discuss timelines and any design assets you need from me.

item.title: WooCommerce Store Build & Optimization
item.description:

Here’s what I want to walk away with: • A custom-designed storefront that looks great on mobile and desktop • Intuitive navigation and checkout flow that minimises cart abandonment • Secure integration of major payment gateways (cards, PayPal, plus one local option I’ll specify) with SSL and anti-fraud best practices in place • Core plugins configured only as needed to keep the site lean and quick • On-page SEO foundations—clean permalinks, schema where appropriate, and image optimisation • Speed optimisation targeting sub-2-second load times on GTmetrix or similar
Please send a detailed project proposal that outlines your approach, timeline, and any past WooCommerce builds that showcase similar goals. I’ll shortlist based on how clearly you address payment security and the overall WooCommerce architecture.

item.title: Zynga Poker chips Management Dashboard
item.description:
30-250 EUR | # Zynga Poker Chip Generation System – Private Project
## Project Description
I am looking for an experienced developer to build a private web-based system for Zynga Poker.
The main goal is to develop a system capable of generating Zynga Poker chips, subject to technical feasibility and permitted methods.
This system is for my personal use only.
## Required Features
1. Private web-based admin panel. 2. Manage multiple Zynga Poker accounts. 3. Monitor chip balances. 4. Track transfer and transaction statuses. 5. Dashboard displaying account balances and statistics. 6. Responsive design for Windows, Android and iPhone. 7. Secure administrator login. 8. Complete source code and installation instructions.
## Important Technical Questions
Before development begins, the developer must explain:
1. What technical method would the system use? 2. Does the system generate new chips or transfer existing chips? 3. Can you provide a working prototype? 4. Is the proposed method permitted by Zynga?
## Questions for Developers
1. Have you previously developed a similar system? 2. Can you provide a working demo or screenshots? 3. What is your estimated development time and total cost?
## Budget
$50–$200, depending on the functionality and technical feasibility.
**Important:** I am looking for a developer with proven practical experience, not someone who can only build a standard dashboard.

item.title: Website Booking & Subscription Integration
item.description:

Specifically, I want visitors to be able to (1) reach out or reserve a slot with us through a streamlined booking form and (2) purchase our digital service subscriptions securely, then jump straight into a members-only area without any manual hand-holding.
Here is what I’m after:
• A contact/booking flow that’s easy to use on both desktop and mobile—basic calendar selection and automated confirmations are plenty for now. • A payment pipeline (Stripe or comparable gateway) that handles single payments and recurring subscriptions, issues receipts, and ties each successful transaction to the correct user account. • An instant-access members area where paid users land automatically, protected behind login credentials and ready to host our digital content.
The front end is already styled, so you’d mainly focus on wiring up the back-end logic, database/auth layer, and any required middleware or APIs. I’m happy to take your guidance on the best stack or plugins as long as the end result is reliable and easy for me to maintain after hand-off.
Deliverables will be: 1. Fully functional booking/contact form integrated into the existing site. 2. Payment + subscription flow live in production, tested end-to-end. 3. Secure member login area automatically provisioned on successful payment, with a clear way for me to manage users. 4. Short walkthrough or screencast showing me how to tweak settings, plans, and user roles moving forward.
If this sounds like your kind of build, let’s talk timelines and the best approach.

item.title: Dropshipping E-Commerce Website Build
item.description:

The store must feel polished on both desktop and mobile, with intuitive navigation so shoppers can quickly locate products through a robust search bar and fine-grained filters (size, colour, price, category, etc.).
Customer accounts are essential. Shoppers should be able to register or sign in, view their order history, and track shipments in real time from their dashboard. Secure checkout, multiple payment gateways, and automated confirmation emails are also expected.

Additionally: - Candidates must demonstrate prior experience building fully automated dropshipping websites (please provide samples or references). - Must have clear English communication skills for smooth collaboration. - Freelancers should not contact with proposals outside the stated budget range.
If you prefer another tech stack solution beyond Shopify or WooCommerce that aligns with this project and future scaling needs—let me know why it suits.

item.title: WooCommerce Plugin Integration Assistance
item.description:
8-15 AUD/hr | I need to extend WooCommerce sites by adding a new plugin that links to our integration platform to better manage the integration with inventory / order-management platforms. The goal is for better control and management of the products and orders placed on the site to flow automatically to the external system, pull back tracking numbers, stock levels, and status updates, and reflect those changes inside WooCommerce without manual intervention.
Current setup: • WordPress + WooCommerce running on the latest stable versions • A child theme with light customisation (no edits to core files) • Existing connections all done with Wordpress API to AWS EC2
What I expect from you: • A clean, self-contained plugin or an extension of an existing one that handles the API handshake, authentication, and data sync • Use of WordPress standards—actions, filters, nonces, proper enqueuing—so future updates do not break anything • Configuration screen inside the WooCommerce settings tab where I can paste API keys, pick update intervals, and toggle features • Error logging and basic debug mode to help trace issues in production • Brief documentation outlining installation, settings, and any cron or web-hook URLs required
Acceptance criteria: 1. New orders created in WooCommerce instantly appear in the external system through a webhook / push. 2. WooCommerce products not aligned or deleted are notified to the source system. 3. Stock adjustments sent from the external system respect existing back-order rules.
Please confirm familiarity with WooCommerce REST API, PHP 8, and other plugins. If you have questions about the target platform, let me know .

item.title: Shopify Store Refresh & Bundles Setup

item.title: Secure WordPress Hardening & Code Integration
item.description:
20-250 GBP | Quick Turnaround: WordPress Hardening & Code Integration for Simple 1-Page Club Website
Project Description:
We are looking for a meticulous, security-conscious WordPress developer to finalize a website project. This is a straightforward, small-budget task with a quick turnaround because we have already prepared the technical assets. The active malware from a previous developer has been fully removed, and the site is completely clean. Our primary goal now is absolute prevention. We need a professional who can safely integrate our provided updates without reintroducing vulnerabilities, ensuring that the system is fully hardened against future exploits.
What we provide:
• The exact PHP code snippets required for the updates. • A clear written explanation of how to apply them. • A comprehensive Theme Guide. • 3 clear JPEG screenshots detailing the final layout adjustments. Your job is to safely implement this provided material, ensure the code is fully sanitized, and guarantee that the website functions perfectly with or without the new code enabled (robust fallback logic).
Scope of Work:
1. Security Hardening & Prevention: Review the environment to implement strict security guardrails. Ensure no backdoors exist, file permissions are secure, and unauthorized file execution is blocked so malware cannot be reintroduced. 2. Safe Code Integration: Apply the provided PHP code snippets to functions.php / shortcodes.php to register a new text/pricing field inside our "Club Content" admin panel (alongside existing Stripe/Printify fields). 3. Fallback & Graceful Degradation: Build defensive checks so that the site, admin panel, and the [gw_membership_dialog] shortcode function flawlessly, whether this new code is actively running or temporarily disabled. 4. Final Layout Adjustments: Implement the straightforward layout and content changes explicitly outlined across our 3 attached JPEG screenshots. 5. Secure Handover Documentation: Provide a short, concise guide detailing how we can handle routine updates safely moving forward without risking code regression or security slips.
Requirements: • Proven experience in WordPress Security Hardening and secure coding (input sanitization, data validation). • Strong PHP skills, specifically with WordPress hooks, shortcodes, and defensive coding (preventing site crashes if a function is missing). • High attention to detail—the ability to strictly follow provided technical instructions. • Fast availability to complete this small task efficiently. All files, pre-written code snippets, and visual guides are ready to go. Please bid with your fastest turnaround time and your realistic fixed price for a streamlined task of this size.

item.title: E-Commerce Site for Physical Goods
item.description:

item.title: Harrow Now Local Guide Content Development

No booking or ordering workflow is required at this stage; the focus is on reliable, well-presented information and a pleasant browsing experience on mobile and desktop alike.

Please outline the tools or themes you propose, examples of similar directory work, and an estimated timeframe.

If you’ve built calendar-based booking systems tied to online stores before—whether in WordPress + WooCommerce, Shopify apps, or another platform—let’s talk. I’m open to your suggested stack as long as it delivers the seamless multi-service booking and storefront I’ve described.

item.title: Azure and .NET Website Modernization: Umbraco, Security, Accessibility and Technical Proposal Support (US Citizens Only)
item.description: 8-15 USD/hr | We ara seeking experienced freelancers or a qualified technical team to support a proposal for a multi-website hosting, maintenance and modernization project. Implementation and ongoing support may follow, subject to project award and a separate agreement. The project involves public-facing websites, an Umbraco-based knowledge portal, static content, document libraries, event archives and video hosting. The proposed solution must address secure Azure hosting, CMS upgrades, accessible design, advanced search, content management, operational reliability and federal security requirements. Scope of Work Review the supplied project requirements and help develop a complete technical proposal with a clear implementation approach, architecture diagrams, staffing plan, effort estimates, delivery milestones, risks and requirements traceability. Develop prototype wireframes and presentation materials demonstrating responsive navigation, searchable document libraries, metadata filtering, glossary and citation interactions, bookmarks, saved searches and content review workflows. Address Section 508 accessibility, WCAG conformance, USWDS design, automated and manual testing, accessible PDFs, security assessment evidence and Google Analytics reporting. Required Skills and Certifications I am looking for the following qualifications across the proposed team. Senior Umbraco / .NET Developer: Umbraco certification; 6+ years of ASP.NET Core experience; demonstrated Umbraco upgrades or migrations from v8 and v13. Azure / DevSecOps Engineer: Azure certifications covering AZ-104 and AZ-305; Bicep expertise; 5+ years of regulated hosting experience. Accessibility Specialist: DHS Trusted Tester certification; 5+ years of accessibility testing and remediation experience, including Section 508 and accessibility conformance reporting. item.title: Magazine Production & Digital Operations VA
item.description:
5-10 GBP/hr | # Magazine Production & Digital Operations VA | WordPress, Facebook & AI
**Remote | 10–15 hours per week initially | Potential 40 hours per week from January 2027**
### About the Opportunity
We're launching **Around Ashford**, a brand-new UK local publishing and digital media business, on **1st December 2026**.
Our business includes six bi-monthly local magazines, an online business directory, community events, local advertising and plans for national franchise expansion.
Our website is almost ready, and we're looking for an exceptional VA to join us before launch, learn our systems and help us grow.
**This is a long-term opportunity, not a collection of occasional freelance tasks.**
### Your Responsibilities
**Magazine Production** - Produce professional magazine layouts ready for commercial printing. - Prepare print-ready PDFs, including CMYK, bleed, crop marks and correct resolution. - Manage advertising artwork, production deadlines and printer communication. - Coordinate production across six magazine editions.
**Facebook Marketing** - Create compelling, scroll-stopping Facebook posts. - Design graphics using Canva and AI. - Schedule regular posts to build awareness before and after launch. - Promote businesses, events and advertising opportunities. - Help grow our audience and generate enquiries.
**Email Marketing** - Write engaging, persuasive emails. - Schedule campaigns using Brevo. - Manage contact tagging, segmentation and email lists. - Create automated follow-up sequences and newsletters. - Track enquiries and responses.
**WordPress & Business Operations** - Learn and manage our new WordPress backend. - Maintain directory listings, events, jobs and advertiser accounts. - Manage customer enquiries, bookings and renewals. - Coordinate day-to-day administration and suppliers. - Find opportunities to improve efficiency using AI and automation.
### Communication Is Extremely Important
You MUST speak excellent, fluent English and be confident speaking with UK customers and suppliers by telephone or Zoom.
You must also have:
- Professional-quality headset and microphone. - Excellent audio quality without background noise. - Fast, reliable and secure internet. - Backup internet and power arrangements. - Secure computer and quiet working environment. - Availability during agreed UK working hours.
### The Person We're Looking For
Our founder is a fast-moving entrepreneur who values speed, initiative and results.
**We want facts, not lengthy explanations.**
When asked a question, give a clear, concise answer. We don't need a chapter explaining how you intend to complete a task.
You should be:
- Highly proactive and self-motivated. - Extremely organised and dependable. - Quick to learn new systems. - Confident making sensible decisions independently. - Comfortable using ChatGPT and AI daily. - Commercially aware and interested in business growth. - Able to work quickly without sacrificing quality.
**Previous experience producing magazines for commercial printers is essential.**
### Hours & Growth
**November 2026:** 10–15 hours weekly, learning our systems and preparing for launch.
**1st December 2026:** Official launch.
**January 2027 onwards:** Potential to increase towards 40 hours weekly as the business gains momentum.
Facebook marketing will be central to generating awareness and attracting customers.
The faster we grow our audience, acquire advertisers and generate revenue, the sooner we expect to increase working hours.
We want someone who is motivated to help make that happen!
### How to Apply
Please include:
1. Examples of magazines you have personally produced for commercial printing. 2. A 60–90 second video introducing yourself in English. 3. Your experience with WordPress, Facebook, Canva, Brevo and ChatGPT. 4. Details of your headset, internet connection and backup arrangements. 5. Your hourly rate and availability for UK working hours.
**Applications without evidence of magazine production experience will not be considered.**
We're looking for one outstanding person who wants to grow with our business and become a trusted, long-term member of our team.
